items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: I did get to use it in that festival with the German band I had... Alexander's big mouth was always involved with Ray McKinley too... I was put down very early on for being too wild... right after you had been writing for Ray McKinley

ctx.x: In that Metronome interview, it is interesting, especially for me since I had that involvement with that Boyd Raeburn project recently, you mention in there that George Handy, who at the time was writing for the Raeburn band and was doing really, quite a few adventurous things, you mentioned that he was doing the things for Boyd that you'd really not had a chance to do with the bands that you worked with.
Right. I did them for McKinley, but he didn't play them either. Not those. They didn't even do them in Sauter-Finegan.
